title: Footprinting — Network Service Enumeration
summary: Systematic enumeration of enterprise services including DNS, mail, SMB/NFS, SNMP, databases and remote management.
documentationStatus: Hands-on practice; full module not verified

title: Shells & Payloads — Windows, Linux and Web Initial Access
summary: A complete 17-section module journal covering shell fundamentals, Windows/Linux initial access, web shells, troubleshooting and defensive analysis.

title: Using the Metasploit Framework — Technical Study and Lab Report
summary: An evidence-aware technical study of Meterpreter, external Metasploit modules, MSFVenom and firewall/IDS evasion, supplemented by recorded FortiLogger and MS17-010 lab observations.

title: Password Attacks — Module Report and NEXURA Skills Assessment
summary: A 26-section module journal with the complete NEXURA Skills Assessment, preserving privileged SMB authentication results, failed extraction attempts and third-party reference boundaries.

title: Vulnerability Assessment — Concepts, Scanner Analysis and Reporting
summary: A complete 17-section module journal covering security assessment methodologies, CVSS scoring, Nessus and OpenVAS scanner configuration, verified Linux anonymous FTP findings, and professional reporting.

title: File Transfers — Windows, Linux and Living-off-the-Land Methods
summary: A complete 10-section module journal covering Windows and Linux file transfer methods, Living-off-the-Land binaries, transport protection, and defensive telemetry correlation.

title: Attacking Common Services — Penetration Testing and Hard Assessment
summary: A comprehensive 19-section module report covering FTP, SMB, MSSQL, MariaDB, RDP, DNS, and SMTP attack paths, featuring verified Easy, Medium, and Hard skills assessments with linked-server sysadmin impersonation and xp_cmdshell SYSTEM access.
